known_defects.detail: commit 27b86c2 changed _SYSTEM_PROMPT but left PROMPT_VERSION at 'coding-tools-json-v24', so one identifier named two different prompt texts; tests/test_model_policy.py already expected v25, leaving HEAD red (335 passed, 1 failed).
known_defects.resolution: successor branch sets PROMPT_VERSION to coding-tools-json-v25; historic trajectories keep v24

known_defects.detail: pyproject.toml declares no dependencies; torch and peft come from the base image via --system-site-packages; a peft 0.21.0 overlay at /root/autodl-tmp is required but not recorded in the repository.
